data.title: Bank fee increase for Girokonto Klassik – your consent needed
data.summary: Musterbank eG wants to raise the monthly account fee for your Girokonto Klassik from €4.90 to €6.90 from 1 December 2026. It needs your express consent by 30 November 2026; silence does not count as consent.
data.explanation: Your bank proposes a higher monthly account fee (€6.90 instead of €4.90) from 1 December 2026. Because of a Federal Court of Justice ruling, it may only apply this if you actively agree, either in online banking or with the signed reply form. If you don't agree, the bank reserves the right to terminate the account with two months' notice. You may also close the account free of charge at any time. The bank mentions a free "Start" account for people in education up to age 27, which could be worth asking about. Decide before the date shown; consider comparing other banks.
